verdict.rationale: Independent benchmarks (Tom's Hardware, HN discussions) confirm strong multi-threaded 'productivity' performance and give concrete comparisons to Zen 5 (9950X), corroborating heavy parallel-job capability, but AMD is often reported as equal or ahead in raw multi-core throughput and perf-per-watt, and a hands-on report describes compiler segmentation faults on Arrow Lake unless specific-speed DDR5 RAM is used, plus a messy Windows launch affecting performance consistency. The evidence pack itself never states documented core counts (only cache/clock in docs-24), leaving the 'documented core counts and boost behavior' half of the story thin. Missing for 10: explicit core-count/boost-clock documentation, independent Linux/compile-specific multi-core benchmark corroboration, and resolution of the compiler-stability caveat.
